title: Forward document drops to the containment so the panel creates an icon launcher
line: Dropping a file or link on an empty part of the task manager now offers to add it to the panel as an icon, instead of doing nothing.
explanation: The task manager's drop area covers its whole width, so the panel never sees drops there. Its handler only pinned application .desktop files or opened the URLs in the hovered task; anything else dropped on empty space was silently ignored, even though the cursor showed it would be accepted. Now such drops are passed to the panel's containment (processMimeData at the drop position), so it behaves exactly like dropping on the panel itself: the panel's menu offers Add Icon (or other matching widgets) and places the new widget next to the task manager. Nothing is forwarded when the panel is locked.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: forward other drops on empty space to the panel

Dropping a document or link on an empty part of the task manager did
nothing. Now it is handed to the containment like a drop on the panel
itself, which offers to add it as an icon or another matching widget.

BUG: 389613

media.caption: Dragging notes.txt from the desktop onto the empty part of the icons-only task manager: nothing happens.
Same drop: the panel's menu appears and Add Icon puts a notes.txt icon on the panel.
Panel after the drop: new icon for notes.txt at the right end.
